messages:
olivia: Heads up — Prospect 'NimbusEdge' POC failing large-batch inference with cascading 503s during throughput ramp. Demo in 6 hours. Need immediate war-room. @rene can you triage? :rotating_light:
rene: on it. which model and which pool? any recent config changes?
olivia: using text-generation-2 on hosted dedicated pool. customer asked for a temporary capacity lift yesterday; we applied a 'capacity bridge' but logs show worker OOMs and queue backpressure.
hao: logs from infra: ```
2026-03-23T02:10:12Z ERROR worker-7 OOM while allocating 1.2G
2026-03-23T02:10:12Z WARN scheduler: queue_length=72 latency_p50=480ms latency_p95=1.8s route=/v1/generate status=503
```
rene: sounds like memory pressure + insufficient batching headroom. Can we throttle batch size or fallback to the quantized variant?
kevin: fallback to q4_0 variant would cut mem by ~40% and keep latency reasonable. We can enable a model-variant fallback policy for this account for the demo window. Also we should add a soft-limit on batch size to reduce OOM risk.
olivia: customer will accept fallback if we communicate. SalesOps: any billing implications for temporary variant switch or capacity bridge?
salesops-bot: note: temporary capacity bridge and model-variant fallback are billable. Please log order id and approval in CRM.
hao: mitigation steps: 1) enable model-variant fallback for account nimbus-001 (fast); 2) set max_batch_size=64 for the pool (config reload); 3) monitor queue and memory metrics. I can patch and reload in ~12m.
rene: I'll prepare a short explanation for the customer, include curl examples to verify. Also adding a healthcheck that returns degraded but available if fallback used.
kevin: pushing feature-flagged fallback now. infra-bot: apply config change request queued by hao
infra-bot: config change applied to pool dedicated-nimbus - rolling restart 3 pods
hao: pods restarting now, running smoke tests with mixed load.
rene: smoke shows 200s with fallback enabled, p95 latency ~1.2s under 500 concurrent. Sending example test command: ```curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"ping"}'```
olivia: great. Action items: hao -> revert capacity bridge after demo ends and add postmortem; kevin -> document fallback policy and add to runbook; rene -> send customer note + verification steps; olivia -> confirm billing with procurement. Keep thread updates here.
kevin: I'll also open a follow-up to tune autoscale thresholds to prevent future OOMs when we see sustained queue >60%.
olivia: thanks team. if anything regresses tag me and I'll coordinate with exec sponsor. :pray:
